Libraries used

```{r}
# two of the required packages are installed from GitHub
# library(remotes)
# remotes::install_github("EDIorg/EMLassemblyline")
# remotes::install_github("WHOIGit/ediutilities")

library(EMLassemblyline)
library(ediutilities)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

Read data table

```{r}
poc_mvco <- read.csv(here('nes-lter-poc-mvco_copy20261109_badremoved.csv'))
```

Add Tioga cruise number

```{r}

df <- read_excel('List of MVCO cruises for NES-LTER project 20260213.xlsx', sheet = "catalog", skip = 6)
Tioga_ID <- df %>% select(1, 3, 4, 5)

poc_mvco <- left_join(poc_mvco, Tioga_ID, by = "event_number")

poc_mvco <- poc_mvco %>%
  select(-date)  %>%

  relocate(ship, .before = date_time_utc) %>%
  relocate(cruise, .before = date_time_utc)

poc_mvco <- poc_mvco %>%
  rename(cruise_ID = cruise)

poc_mvco[] <- lapply(poc_mvco, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) x[x == "NA"] <- NA
  return(x)
})

```


```{r}

poc_mvco <- poc_mvco |>
  mutate(PON_micromolar = case_when(N_quality_flag == 6 ~ 0, TRUE ~ PON_micromolar)) |>
  mutate(PON_microg_perL = case_when(N_quality_flag == 6 ~ 0, TRUE ~ PON_microg_perL))

```

```{r}

poc_mvco$C_quality_flag <- as.factor(poc_mvco$C_quality_flag)
poc_mvco$N_quality_flag <- as.factor(poc_mvco$N_quality_flag)
poc_mvco$date_time_utc <- as.POSIXct(poc_mvco$date_time_utc)

ggplot(poc_mvco, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = POC_microg_perL, color = C_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = POC_microg_perL, color = ship)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral", na.value = "gray50")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = PON_microg_perL, color = N_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = PON_microg_perL, color = ship)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral", na.value = "gray50")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = C_to_N_molar_ratio, color = N_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

# NES-LTER transect POC data file copied locally from its repo
# good alternatives are to access from EDI or GitHub
#https://portal.edirepository.org/nis/mapbrowse?scope=knb-lter-nes&identifier=27&revision=newest
# https://github.com/WHOIGit/nes-lter-poc-transect/blob/main/nes-lter-poc-transect-input.csv

poc_transect <- read.csv(here('nes-lter-poc-transect.csv'))
#data_table$date_time_utc = ymd_hms(data_table$date)

# filter by position

# Transect MVCO ranges lat =  41.3125 - 41.3269, lon = -70.5629 to -70.5857
# MVCO_nut_copy ranges lat = 41.1364 - 41.339, lon = -70.4151 to -70.6839
lat_min <- 41.13
lat_max <- 41.33
lon_min <- -70.68
lon_max <- -70.41
# Filter rows within the specified range of latitude and longitude
filtered_poc <- poc_transect |>
  filter(latitude >= lat_min & latitude <= lat_max,
         longitude >= lon_min & longitude <= lon_max)

filtered_poc <- filtered_poc |>
  mutate(ship = case_when(
    grepl("^AR", cruise) ~ "Neil Armstrong",
    grepl("^AT", cruise) ~ "Atlantis",
    grepl("^EN", cruise) ~ "Endeavor",
    grepl("^HRS", cruise) ~ "Hugh R. Sharp",
    grepl("^AE", cruise) ~ "Atlantic Explorer",
    TRUE ~ ""  # Set to empty string for unmatched cases
      ),
    event_number = paste(cruise, cast, sep = "_"),  
    event_number_niskin = paste(cruise, cast, niskin, sep = "_"), 
    cruise_ID = cruise
  )

# eliminate columns:
#filtered_poc <- select(filtered_poc, -cruise, -cast, -niskin)

# Merge transect data with mvco
common_columns <- intersect(names(poc_mvco), names(filtered_poc))
filtered_poc_aligned <- filtered_poc %>% select(all_of(common_columns))
#missing_columns <- setdiff(names(poc_mvco), names(filtered_poc_aligned))
#filtered_poc_aligned[missing_columns] <- NA
#filtered_poc_aligned <- filtered_poc_aligned %>% select(names(poc_mvco))

filtered_poc_aligned$date_time_utc <- as.POSIXct(filtered_poc_aligned$date_time_utc)
filtered_poc_aligned$C_quality_flag <- as.factor(filtered_poc_aligned$C_quality_flag)
filtered_poc_aligned$N_quality_flag <- as.factor(filtered_poc_aligned$N_quality_flag)

poc_mvco_all <- bind_rows(poc_mvco, filtered_poc_aligned)

poc_mvco_all <- poc_mvco_all[order(poc_mvco_all$date_time_utc), ]

```

```{r}

poc_mvco_all$C_quality_flag <- as.factor(poc_mvco_all$C_quality_flag)
poc_mvco_all$N_quality_flag <- as.factor(poc_mvco_all$N_quality_flag)

ggplot(poc_mvco_all, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = POC_microg_perL, color = C_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+

  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco_all, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = POC_microg_perL, color = ship)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral", na.value = "gray50")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco_all, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = PON_microg_perL, color = N_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco_all, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = PON_microg_perL, color = ship)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral", na.value = "gray50")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_mvco_all, aes(x = date_time_utc, y = C_to_N_molar_ratio, color = N_quality_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_minimal()


```


```{r}
# write csv file for package
write.csv(poc_mvco_all, "nes-lter-poc-mvco.csv", na = "NaN", row.names = FALSE)
```

Read data table

```{r}

data_table <- read.csv(here('nes-lter-poc-mvco.csv'))

# identify date column for ediutilities package to generate temporal coverage
data_table$date = ymd_hms(data_table$date_time_utc)

```

Read the Excel metadata template and generate text templates used by
EMLassemblyline

```{r}
excel_to_template(here('nes-lter-poc-mvco-info'), 'nes-lter-poc-mvco', rights='CC0', file_type=".md")

```
Generate the package and insert the parent project node into the resulting EML

```{r}
# provide package ID
pkg_id <- 'knb-lter-nes.28.1'

make_eml(here(),
         dataset.title="Particulate organic carbon (POC) and nitrogen (PON) from the Martha's Vineyard Coastal Observatory (MVCO), ongoing since 2012 (NES-LTER since 2017)",
         data.table='nes-lter-poc-mvco.csv',
         data.table.description='Amount of particulate organic carbon and nitrogen from water column bottle samples taken near the Marthas Vineyard Coastal Observatory',
         data.table.name = 'nes-lter-poc-mvco',
         temporal.coverage = temporal_coverage(data_table$date),
         geographic.description = "NES-LTER Transect",
         geographic.coordinates = geographic_coordinates(data_table$latitude, data_table$longitude),
         maintenance.description = "ongoing",
         user.id = "NES",
         user.domain = "LTER",
         package.id = pkg_id)

project_insert(pkg_id, "parent_project_NESI-II_RAPID.txt")
```
